then OFFHOOK=1; break; fi; sleep 0.5; done; test "$OFFHOOK" = "1"; APK=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | cut -d: -f2 | head -n1); test -n "$APK"; for RATE in 16000 48000; do echo === live_construct_$RATE ===; set +e; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.CallAssistantAudioProbe construct $RATE"; RC=$?; set -e; echo live_construct_${RATE}_exit=$RC; done; echo '=== AUDIO LOGCAT ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v brief | grep -i -E 'AudioTrack|AudioPolicy|AudioFlinger|getOutputForAttr|createTrack|CALL_ASSISTANT|INCALL_MUSIC|telephony' | tail -n 600 || true; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py hangup; trap - EXIT; sleep 1; POST=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); echo post_call_state=$POST; test "$POST" = "0"; echo phase1c_live_construct_remote_complete=true
